item.title: Haystack Launches Central Index for Community Integrations
item.description:
Haystack Launches Central Index for Community Integrations

A new repository provides an index of Haystack integrations that can be used with a Haystack Pipeline or Agent.

📂 Overview

This repository lists integrations that are maintained by their respective owners or authors and can be browsed on the Haystack Integrations page.

🛠️ Types of Integrations

  • Document Store
  • Model Provider
  • Data Ingestion
  • Monitoring Tool
  • Evaluation Framework
  • Custom Component
  • Tool Integration
  • Something new!

📄 Contribution Guide

  • Create a pull request adding a .md file to the integrations/ directory.
  • Start with the draft integration page: https://github.com/deepset-ai/haystack-integrations/blob/main/draft-integration.md
  • Include required frontmatter fields (see table).
  • Ensure at least one of pypi or repo fields is present.
  • After merging, the integration will appear on the integrations page.

🗂️ Frontmatter Fields

Field Requirement
layout required
name required
description required
authors required (name of each author)
type required
toc optional
logo optional
version required (Haystack 2.0)
pypi optional (must include if no repo)
repo optional (must include if no pypi)
report_issue optional

🚀 Availability

Browse all integrations on the Haystack Integrations page (https://haystack.deepset.ai/integrations) to see author information, installation instructions, and usage details.

#Haystack #Integrations #OpenSource #MachineLearning

Source: deepset-ai/haystack-integrations

item.title: Haystack 3.0 Released: Open‑Source Framework for Production‑Ready LLM Apps
item.description:
Haystack 3.0 Released: Open‑Source Framework for Production‑Ready LLM Apps

Haystack 3.0 has been released as an open‑source AI orchestration framework for building production‑ready LLM applications in Python.

🔍 Overview

  • Open‑source AI orchestration framework for building context‑engineered, production‑ready LLM applications.
  • Built for Python developers.

🧩 How it works

  • Design modular pipelines and agent workflows.
  • Provides explicit control over retrieval, routing, memory, and generation.

⚙️ Key details

  • Scalable agents and Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG) systems.
  • Multimodal applications, semantic search, and conversational systems.
  • Supports question answering and autonomous agents.
  • Transparent architecture that lets you experiment and customize deeply.

🚀 Availability

  • Haystack 3.0 is out! The framework is publicly available as open‑source code.

💡 Why it matters

  • Gives developers a clear, modular way to build and tune LLM‑based applications with full control over core components.

#Haystack #LLM #RAG #OpenSource

Source: deepset-ai/haystack
